title: CCRUM Various Post Online Form 2026
organization: Central Council for Research in Unani Medicine
postName: Group A, B & C Various Posts (Research Officer, Staff Nurse, Pharmacist, UDC, LDC, MTS, Stenographer etc.)
vacancyDetails: About 179–180 Group A, B & C posts including Research Officer, Staff Nurse, Pharmacist, Investigator, UDC, LDC, MTS, Stenographer and others under CCRUM Advt 2026
qualification: Post-wise: Medical / Unani / Nursing / Pharmacy / Graduate / 10+2 / Matric as per Group A/B/C post requirements in detailed vacancy PDF
ageLimit: As per post and CCRUM / Central Govt rules (relaxations applicable)
applicationFee: Group A/B: UR/OBC ₹1500 | SC/ST/PH/Female ₹500 (processing). Group C: UR/OBC ₹1300 | SC/ST/PH/Female ₹500 (as per notice)
selectionProcess: Online Application → Written / CBT / Skill Test as per post → Document Verification → Appointment
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, registration (nursing/pharmacy), category certificate, ID proof
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ccrum.res.in or apply portal https://ccrum.in/register
2. Register for CCRUM Various Post 2026
3. Fill form carefully as per Group A/B/C post
4. Upload documents and pay processing fee
5. Submit by 31 July 2026; correction 03–05 August 2026 if notified
shortDescription: CCRUM Various Post Online Form 2026 for ~180 Group A/B/C posts. Apply 01–31 July 2026; correction 03–05 Aug 2026. Ministry of AYUSH – ccrum.res.in.
content:
The Central Council for Research in Unani Medicine (CCRUM), Ministry of AYUSH, has invited online applications for about 180 various Group A, B and C posts.

Application period: 01 July 2026 to 31 July 2026. Correction window reported: 03–05 August 2026.

Posts include

  • Research Officer / Investigator (Group A/B)
  • Staff Nurse, Pharmacist
  • UDC, LDC, Stenographer, MTS and other support posts

Fee and eligibility vary by group. Download the bilingual detailed vacancy advertisement from ccrum.res.in and apply via the official registration link.
